summary: Sequenced audit webhook: ordered delivery, resume-on-failure, ACKs and tamper-evident manifest request
description:
Issue summary: FinServCo's compliance team requires an evidentiary sample and confirmation that the audit webhook delivery to their SIEM (HTTPS POST to https://siem.finservco.example/ingest) supports ordered (monotonic) delivery, durable resume after transient failures, per-batch ACK receipts, and a tamper-evident manifest (HMAC or signed checkpoints) for chain-of-custody. Impact: inability to complete external audit for account scoped export. They observed gaps during a simulated network interruption and want proof of delivery guarantees and sample signed manifests.

Customer asks: 1) sample payloads and signed manifest covering a 24-hour window, 2) design explanation of resume and sequencing guarantees, 3) suggested consumer-side ACK validation and replay-protection guidance, 4) timeline for producing SOC-evidence bundle.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer configures a tenant-scoped webhook (delivery endpoint as above) with 'ordered_delivery=true' in Console. 2) Simulate intermittent connectivity by dropping TCP for 30s during bursts. 3) Observe ingestion gaps and duplicated events on their SIEM. 4) Request proof of delivery and the signed manifest for the window 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-02T00:00:00Z.
observed_behavior: Customer reports out-of-order events after a transient network interruption and missing sequence numbers for multiple batches. They also report not receiving any explicit ACK; only HTTP 200s logged on our side but their SIEM shows duplicates once the endpoint resumed.
expected_behavior: Webhook delivery should include monotonic sequence numbers per-tenant, idempotent batch IDs with exponential retry and backoff on transient 5xx/timeout, explicit delivery ACKs in response body (x-delivery-ack header or JSON ack), and a cryptographically-signed manifest containing checkpoint offsets/checksums for legal chain-of-custody.
logs: Support logs: request_id=ce2b9a1f-7d3a-4b2f-8e9d-0b12f3c6a123 delivery attempt timestamps: 2026-03-02T14:12:03Z (500), 2026-03-02T14:12:12Z (timeout), 2026-03-02T14:12:42Z (200). Webhook proxy logs show retry-policy=exponential; payload_size=12.4KB; sequence_start=84012; sequence_end=84022. HMAC verification status: N/A (customer not configured verification header).
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10: Initial triage by support (Aisha). Confirmed customer's tenant has ordered_delivery flag set. 2026-03-11: Eng (Marco) reproduced a transient-drop locally against a mock endpoint and saw our connector requeue batches but we discovered current delivery ACK semantics rely on HTTP 2xx only (no structured ACK). 2026-03-11: Hypothesis: duplicates observed by customer are due to their endpoint returning 200 for receipt but not persisting, then replay after timeout. 2026-03-12: Verified webhook proxy emits X-Sequence-Range and X-Batch-Id headers. No signed checkpoint produced for webhook deliveries originally; manifests are produced for SFTP batch exports only. 2026-03-12: Created a prototype PR to attach signed checkpoint header on final successful delivery and persist checkpoint to audit-blob-store. See PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5821.
comments: 2026-03-10 | Aisha Patel (Support): Acknowledged customer and requested sample window + preferred signing algorithm (HMAC-SHA256 or RSA-SHA256). Asked for endpoint logs from their SIEM.

2026-03-11 | FinServCo - Compliance (Elena M.): Provided endpoint logs showing duplicated batches and missing sequence numbers 84015-84018. Requested formal attestation and sample signed manifest covering 2026-03-01.
2026-03-11 | Marco Ruiz (SRE): Reproduced locally. Confirmed delivery backoff and replay behavior. Noted no structured ACK semantics currently; recommend adding an explicit ack response contract.

2026-03-12 | Marco Ruiz (SRE): Deployed prototype to staging: adds 'X-Audit-Checkpoint-Signature' header (HMAC-SHA256) and persists checkpoint to internal audit-blob-store. Need product review before production roll-out.
2026-03-13 | Product (Nora Li): Requested compliance-language for manifest and confirmation that the HMAC key is rotation-capable and KMS-backed. Tagged for Dedicated/Enterprise only.

2026-03-13 | Aisha Patel (Support): Shared interim mitigation steps with customer and ETA for production feature: targeted roll-out in two weeks behind a tenant flag and a signed evidence bundle to be delivered earlier as a one-off export.
resolution:
Workaround: We offered a one-off signed export for the requested 24-hour window within 48 hours. This bundle includes the raw event batches, per-batch checksums (SHA256), a manifest with timestamps and sequence ranges, and an HMAC-SHA256 signature computed with a KMS-backed key. We also recommended customer-side validation steps (idempotent insert by Batch ID and verify monotonic sequence number).

Planned fix: Add structured ACK contract for webhook consumers (application/json {"ack": true, "batch_id": "..."}) and emit X-Audit-Checkpoint-Signature header signed by KMS HMAC key on final delivery. Persist checkpoints in audit-blob-store for replay evidence. Rollout plan: canary in prod for 5% of enterprise tenants with ordered_delivery flag enabled, then full ramp in 2 weeks.

Follow-ups: 1) Create Confluence doc with evidence format and verification instructions (owner: Marco Ruiz). 2) Add e2e test for replay and resume behavior (owner: QA). 3) Deliver SOC-evidence bundle to FinServCo (owner: Aisha Patel).
attachments_note: One-off signed manifest will be generated and delivered to customer in encrypted S3 presigned URL. Keys rotated per KMS policy.
next_steps: Produce one-off evidence bundle and send presigned link to FinServCo (ETA 2026-03-15)
Implement structured ACK contract and add header-signed checkpoint (canary rollout)
Document verification procedure and include sample validators (python snippets)
customer_communication_summary: Customer notified of interim workaround (one-off signed bundle) and given timeline for product fix. Compliance asked for formal attestation language; Product drafting attestation with security to confirm HSM/KMS handling.
note_for_ops: If enabling tenant flag for signed checkpoints, ensure KMS key has appropriate IAM policy and rate limits are considered for signature operations. Monitor audit-blob-store size growth and retention policy.
